protocol: single binding offer; same old bookings and same frozen users in every comparison

selection.selection: one fixed parameter per family maximizing training mean realised M; ties lower candidate index; raw exit excluded from its selected benchmark
selection.logit_scope: Fit only actual public offered/replied records from random calibration. Refusals are probabilistic labels; no private preference bounds are inferred.

model_metadata.objective: actual procurement net saving M; platform cash=.8M; social saving separately G-dD
model_metadata.selection: validation mean M; price variation is not rewarded

explicit_history_ablation: same platform weights and normalization; only explicit history features zeroed; current physical state and admissible-action masks retained
private_accounts: S/user gains are aggregate outcome accounts. Prospective private utility is read only for the one actual published offer and stored separately; it never enters any controller, observer or public-response fit.
